order_wins: **Advait Energy Transitions** -- Rs 130.49 cr order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation to reconductor the 220kV Dahej-Haldarwa lines with higher-ampacity conductor, 15-month execution (~6.5% of mcap).
**Annu Projects** -- Rs 3.82 cr Letter of Acceptance from Indian Oil Corporation (Pipelines Division) for OFC-laying work on the Barauni pipeline, 24-month completion (~1.5% of mcap).

**Dhabriya Polywood** -- two work-order enhancements today: Rs 12.20 cr from Godrej Group and Rs 17.69 cr from M3M Group, both for aluminium door/window/facade works (~5.9% of mcap combined, our arithmetic).
**Positron Energy** -- Letter of Award for ~1,50,000 MMBTU of spot RLNG, worth approx. Rs 40 cr, for supplies through 30-Nov (~19.7% of mcap).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **JTL Defence** -- Rights Issue Committee fixes terms of its already-approved (14-Oct) rights issue: 7,89,472 shares at Rs 311.40 (3-for-2), Rs 24.59 cr, record date 27-Nov.
**Adroit Infotech** -- Board approves up to 1 crore convertible warrants to the promoter group at Rs 13 each, Rs 13 cr, subject to shareholder approval at a 10-Dec EGM.
equity_allotments: **Bajaj Finance** -- discloses the >5% allottee list from its QIP closed 16-Nov: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund (10.26% of the issue) and Government Pension Fund Global (5.12%).
m_and_a: **Apollo Micro Systems** -- subsidiary Apollo Defence Industries signs a binding Expression of Interest for up to 26% of A-Thon Allterrain (all-terrain/side-by-side utility vehicles), the Apollo Group's entry into land systems; price not disclosed, 90-day exclusivity.
**TCPL Packaging** -- signs a joint-venture agreement with Italy's Brandart S.p.A. to explore premium/luxury packaging in Asia-Pacific via a Singapore JV; investment amount not yet decided.

**Prestige Estates** -- subsidiary Prestige Falcon Realty Ventures subscribes to 50% of Advent Convention and Hotels International, turning it from Advent Hotels' wholly-owned unit into a 50:50 JV for a Mumbai commercial project with a Rs 4,500 cr GDV.

**Credent Connect N Care** -- to acquire 26% of Kartavya Healtheon (patient-support and occupational-health services) via secondary purchase, fresh-share subscription and loan conversion; 6% already bought, price for the rest not disclosed.
**AXISCADES Technologies** -- Swiss subsidiary Ulosia Holding completes buying 100% of Germany's Titan 181. VVG GmbH, which becomes a step-down subsidiary; price not disclosed.
**Prestige Estates** -- separately raises its partnership interest in Prestige Vaishnaoi Projects from 38.24% to 42.83%, infusing Rs 110.93 cr.
**Royal Sense** -- board withdraws its scheme of amalgamation with TTG Innovations, first disclosed 26-May-2025; an NCLT withdrawal application is to follow.
capex_core: **Supreme Petrochem** -- signs a technology agreement with Italy's Versalis for a second 70 KTPA mABS line, Rs 450 cr via internal accruals, mechanical completion by Dec-2028.
business_updates: **Results season** — 108 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Fabtech Cleanrooms** -- October order intake of Rs 27.75 cr (Pharma-led), taking its consolidated order book to Rs 468.50 cr.

**Veranda Learning Solutions** -- its demerged Commerce-education arm, J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited, is set to debut on BSE and NSE on 18-Nov; JKSCEL targets Rs 1,000 cr revenue by FY30 (the company's own target).

**Glenmark** -- via Ichnos Glenmark Innovation, submits an IND application to the US FDA for ISB 2301, a first-in-class multispecific immune-cell activator for solid tumors; Phase 1 trial planned for 2027.

**ACME Solar** -- commissions an additional 52.32 MW / 209.28 MWh of BESS at its Bikaner FDRE project (COD 19-Nov), taking cumulative commissioned BESS there to 247.67 MW / 990.68 MWh under its PPA with SJVN.
**Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys** -- starts hot-metal tapping from the second furnace of its Kalinganagar greenfield ferrochrome expansion; the first furnace has run since 25-Aug.
**Delta Autocorp** -- H1 FY27 PAT up 27% YoY to Rs 4.33 cr, EBITDA up 48.6% to Rs 5.05 cr, on electric-scooter volumes up over 200%.
distress_risk: **Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy** -- Supreme Court quashes a ~Rs 59.14 cr GST demand (plus matching penalty) against group entity Sterling and Wilson Pvt Ltd; already covered by an indemnity, so no financial impact on SWREL.

**Procter & Gamble Hygiene & Health Care** -- signs an advance pricing agreement with tax authorities for FY2010-11 to FY2018-19: pays ~Rs 14.3 cr additional tax but cuts contingent liabilities by ~Rs 94 cr.
**Sanofi India** -- a GST show-cause notice over a Rs 23.74 cr claim is dropped by Karnataka tax authorities on payment of just Rs 17,680.
**A-One Steels India** -- NCLT records completion of its Rs 3.80 cr settlement with operational creditor Shri Khatu Shyam Ispat Udyog, which has filed to withdraw its insolvency petition.

**Godrej Properties** -- Haryana Pollution Control Board orders closure of operations at its Sector-3 Gurugram housing project over alleged Air Act non-compliance; also fined Rs 1 lakh by TNRERA over an advertisement.

**Videocon Industries** and group company **Value Industries** -- Supreme Court dismisses multiple civil appeals, including the VOVL foreign oil & gas assets dispute, arising from Videocon's CIRP, closing off that line of challenge.
other_notable: **Spectrum Talent Management** -- receives NSE's in-principle approval to migrate its shares from the EMERGE (SME) platform to the Main Board.
